accents.blue: Accent colour swatch name in Appearance settings, not a noun for the colour itself
accents.green: Accent colour swatch name in Appearance settings
accents.orange: Accent colour swatch name in Appearance settings
accents.purple: Accent colour swatch name in Appearance settings
accents.rose: Accent colour swatch name in Appearance settings
accents.teal: Accent colour swatch name in Appearance settings

readiness.bridgeMissing: Status chip: the agent's ACP bridge package still has to be installed
readiness.cliMissing: Status chip: the agent's command line tool was not found on PATH
readiness.ready: Status chip: the external coding agent can be started
readiness.unavailable: Status chip: this agent cannot run on this machine at all

aiBudget.approximateCost: Marks a money amount as an estimate, for example "~$0.02"

citeOleafly.undo: Toast button that removes the citation entry that was just added

compatibility.blockerFinding_one: The whole message is the finding title supplied by the compatibility scanner; keep it as the bare placeholder
compatibility.chooseEngine: Toast button that opens the compile engine picker

compile.retry: Toast button that starts the compile again after a failure

developer.nav: Settings sidebar entry for the debug-build-only developer panel

filters.pngImage: File type filter shown in the operating system save dialog
filters.zipArchive: File type filter shown in the operating system save dialog

export.saved: {{kind}} is a format name such as PDF or PNG and is never translated
export.showInFolder: Toast button that reveals the exported file in Finder or File Explorer

fonts.systemDefault: Font picker option meaning the operating system's own font is used
fonts.terminalDefault: Font picker option meaning the terminal's own default font stack is used

inlineAi.concise: Inline editor action that shortens the selected text
inlineAi.expand: Inline editor action that adds detail to the selected text, not a tree expand
inlineAi.fixSource: Inline editor action that repairs LaTeX or Typst syntax in the selection
inlineAi.grammar: Inline editor action that corrects spelling and grammar in the selection
inlineAi.improve: Inline editor action that rewrites the selected text more clearly
inlineAi.translate: Inline editor action that translates the selected text into English

intelligence.disposed: Shown when the analysis worker was already shut down before the request
intelligence.disposedDuringRequest: Shown when the analysis worker shut down while the request was in flight
intelligence.staleSnapshot: Shown when the worker no longer holds the analysis the panel asked about

mermaid.diagram: Screen-reader name for a rendered Mermaid diagram
mermaid.rendering: Screen-reader status while a Mermaid diagram is still drawing

navigation.edits_one: Fragment used only inside the renamed message; never shown on its own
navigation.files_one: Fragment used only inside the renamed message; never shown on its own
navigation.renamed: Composed from the edits and files fragments through i18next nesting; keep the $t(...) calls

pandoc.installGuide: Toast button that opens the pandoc installation page in a browser

projectDiagnostics.beginIsHere: {{command}} is a literal LaTeX command such as \begin{figure}; keep it verbatim.
projectDiagnostics.definedHere: Editor diagnostic pointing at another place the same name is defined.

kinds.anchor: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.
kinds.asset: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.
kinds.bibentry: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.
kinds.bibliography: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.
kinds.environment: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.
kinds.file: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.
kinds.glossary: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.
kinds.import: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.
kinds.include: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.
kinds.label: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.
kinds.link: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.
kinds.macro: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.
kinds.section: Noun naming a kind of document symbol or file reference, read inside the surrounding diagnostic sentence.

projectDiagnostics.possibleTarget: Editor diagnostic listing one of several files a reference could point at.

skillGroups.shelf: Heading for the skills Oleafly ships, as opposed to the ones the reader wrote
skillGroups.user: Heading for the skills the reader added themselves

theme.unknownProperty: Substituted into cssPropertyNotAllowed when the offending property name cannot be read

tinytex.installGuide: Toast button that opens the TinyTeX installation page in a browser

phase.addingPackages: Progress label while TinyTeX installs its LaTeX packages
phase.downloading: Progress label while the TinyTeX archive downloads
phase.installing: Generic progress label when the install phase is not known
phase.unpacking: Progress label while the downloaded TinyTeX archive is extracted

status.cancelled: Tool call status: the reader stopped the run
status.declined: Tool call status: the reader refused the approval prompt
status.done: Tool call status: the call finished successfully
status.failed: Tool call status: the call ended with an error
status.interrupted: Tool call status: the run was cut short by something other than the reader
status.running: Tool call status: the call is still in flight
status.timedOut: Tool call status: the call passed its deadline

ui.transparent: Colour-picker option that clears the colour instead of choosing one
